mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.session_no, s.business_domain_id, d.name AS business_domain_name, s.customer_id, s.session_status, s.assigned_to, s.last_message_at, s.closed_at, s.archived_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_message m WHERE m.consultation_session_id = s.id ), 0) AS message_count, ( SELECT t.ticket_no FROM consultation_ticket_link l JOIN ticket t ON t.id = l.ticket_id WHERE l.consultation_session_id = s.id LIMIT 1 ) AS linked_ticket_no FROM consultation_session s JOIN business_domain d ON d.id = s.business_domain_id
mapper.select: SELECT dc.business_domain_id AS domain_id, COALESCE(CAST(days.config_value AS UNSIGNED), 30) AS auto_days FROM domain_config dc LEFT JOIN domain_config days ON days.business_domain_id = dc.business_domain_id AND days.config_key = 'consultation_archive_auto_days' WHERE dc.config_key = 'consultation_archive_auto_enabled' AND dc.config_value = 'true'

SELECT m.id, m.consultation_session_id, m.business_domain_id, s.session_no, m.seq_no, m.sender_user_id, m.sender_role, m.message_type, m.content, CAST(m.payload AS CHAR) AS payload_json, m.created_at, m.retracted_at, m.retracted_by FROM consultation_message m JOIN consultation_session s ON s.id = m.consultation_session_id WHERE m.consultation_session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.seq_no

SELECT m.id, m.consultation_session_id, m.business_domain_id, s.session_no, m.seq_no, m.sender_user_id, m.sender_role, m.message_type, m.content, CAST(m.payload AS CHAR) AS payload_json, m.created_at, m.retracted_at, m.retracted_by FROM consultation_message m JOIN consultation_session s ON s.id = m.consultation_session_id WHERE m.id = #{messageId} AND m.consultation_session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation_session SET assigned_to = #{assignedTo}, session_status = 'open' WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND assigned_to IS NULL AND session_status <> 'closed'

UPDATE consultation_session SET assigned_to = #{assignedTo}, session_status = 'open' WHERE session_no = #{sessionNo} AND business_domain_id = #{domainId} AND assigned_to IS NULL AND session_status <> 'closed'
mapper.select: SELECT t.ticket_no FROM consultation_ticket_link l JOIN ticket t ON t.id = l.ticket_id WHERE l.consultation_session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
